title.narrative: Programme Estimate Support to NAZ

description.narrative: The purpose of this Multi-annual Programme Estimate (PE) is to support the National Assembly of Zambia (NAZ), towards implementation of selected capacity-building activities foreseen under the Support to the National Assembly of Zambia Programme II (NAZ II) project. The NAZ II project includes the PE and a service contract, and forms part of the Support to Effectiveness and Trans-parency in Management of Public Resources (EFFECT) programme, which is supported by the Eu-ropean Union (EU) under the 11th European Development Fund (11th EDF). This PE specifically aims to achieve the following results: _Improved capacity of the legislative scrutiny of the budget; _Improved quality of analytical policy briefs on the budget by the Parliamentary Budget Office (PBO); _Improved quality of Parliamentary Committees recommendations on the budgets; _Enhanced gender-responsive budget analysis.

description.narrative: The Open Budget Index (OBI) assigns each country a score from 0 to 100 based on the simple average of the numerical value of each of the responses to the 109 questions in the questionnaire that assess the public availability of budget information.The Open Budget Survey is a comprehensive analysis and survey that evaluates whether governments give the public access to budget information and opportunities to participate in the budget process at the national level. The Survey also assesses the capacity and independence of formal oversight institutions.
